entities.name: Freya
entities.description: A woman whose life trajectory involves love, hope, betrayal, and the contamination of her legacy.
entities.quote: Freya’s story should feel like: love -> hope -> strain -> failure -> abandonment -> contamination of legacy

entities.name: Khalid
entities.description: An individual who enters Freya's life after her emotional collapse to exploit her vulnerability.
entities.quote: Khalid should enter after the emotional damage already exists. That makes him stronger.

entities.name: Arthur
entities.description: A figure who grows up fueled by a lie regarding the deaths of Freya and Gabriel at the hands of the Duskmoor.
entities.quote: Arthur later grows up with the lie that Gabriel and Freya died by Duskmoor hands

entities.name: Duskmoor
entities.description: A group falsely blamed for the deaths of Freya and Gabriel to facilitate a weaponized version of history.
entities.quote: Arthur later grows up with the lie that Gabriel and Freya died by Duskmoor hands
